purpose: Document first-party local registry/map evidence and bounded anonymous parcel geometry access review.
assessment: Meghalaya’s Directorate of Land Records and Surveys says it surveys and maintains State/District maps. The Government of Meghalaya portal also reports that land surveys have not been conducted since the British period except in a few villages and that no Record of Rights exists in most areas. These broad statements do not identify a present parcel registry or map covering the WUP locator in Shillong. Public administrative/district maps are not parcel geometry. No safe public parcel feature endpoint or native-ID schema was found.
registryAssessment: The official DLRS has a state mapping mandate, but current city-specific parcel registration or point coverage in Shillong was not established. Therefore registry presence for this exact settlement locator remains unresolved.
